tara (Marketing): Quick readiness check for tomorrow's playbook publish. Target lift: 09:30 PT. Need final go/no-go from PR/legal/growth/support. who's on notes?

sam (PR): I'm on reporter outreach. Will send embargo to approved list at 09:25 PT. Reminder: no raw CSVs in the pack.

sue (Legal): One item: remove two partner logos from social cards until written permission comes through. Names in copy are okay if partners already signed.

ana (Design): (typo) ana (Design): Uploaded two sets of cards: with-logos and logo-free in drive. I'll update OG image to the logo-free variant by 09:10 PT.

leo (Growth): Paid promos queued, holding 20% buffer for first 20 minutes. UTMs: utm_campaign=playbook_q2. I'll test preview cards at 09:20 PT.

mike (Product): Product will watch infra 09:00-10:30 PT. We'll alert if p95 latency > 2x baseline.

ara (Support): Support staffing confirmed 09:15-10:45 PT. Adding a 3-bullet FAQ to the press kit now.

publish-bot: reminder scheduled: preview check at 09:18 PT, smoke probe at 09:28 PT.

tara (Marketing): Sam  please include 1-paragraph "how we measured" methodology blurb for quick press Qs. Also watermark affected files "NO SYNDICATION" if we don't have partner sign-off.

sam (PR): Will add methodology blurb and watermark. Draft embargo snippet: 

Hi <name>,
Embargoed until 09:30 PT on 2026-03-26: Redwood Inference will publish the Cost & Efficiency Playbook. We'd like to share embargoed assets and offer a short briefing at 09:28 PT.
Best,
Sam

sue (Legal): Also flag: do NOT promise specific customer outcomes in quotes. Keep language "typical customers see" rather than explicit percentages.

ana (Design): OG + hero updated to logo-free. Link: https://drive.redwood/playbook/assets/v2

leo (Growth): I'll post the first social at 09:31 PT and a deep thread at 12:00 PT. Paused syndication queues until legal clears logos.

tara (Marketing): Final timeline: 09:10 PT final asset check, 09:18 PT preview smoke, 09:25 PT embargo send, 09:28 PT reporter briefing, 09:30 PT publish + social. If anything blocks, call me. :white_check_mark:
